searchText: does anyone know if there's a history of Ethereum wallets somewhere? i.e. how different standards for wallet products evolved since the first few years? I'm trying to put together the order in which these features were/will be built up into wallet products. Thanks! Chapter 5 of Mastering Ethereum is about wallets, but it seems to be a decent overview rather than an account of history. very helpful start, thank you! This discord server is not the place to get the type of support your posts are asking for. This discord is focused on protocol development.
